items: 1 cup peanut butter, crunchy if possible
1 cup roasted salted peanuts, chopped fine

steps.title: Cream the sugars and butter
steps.body: Beat together **1 cup brown sugar**, packed, **1 cup granulated sugar** and **1 cup salted butter**, softened.

steps.title: Add eggs, vanilla and peanut butter
steps.body: Add **2 large eggs**, **2 tsp vanilla** and **1 cup peanut butter**, crunchy if possible.

steps.title: Mix in the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix in **2½ cups flour**, **½ tsp baking soda**, **½ tsp baking powder** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add the peanuts
steps.body: Add **1 cup roasted salted peanuts**, chopped fine, and chocolate chips if desired.

steps.title: Shape the balls
steps.body: Roll into 1½–2-inch balls and place on a cookie sheet. Press balls with forks or potato masher.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for about 10–12 minutes (puffed and slightly brown along edges).
